confirmations.deleteLevel: Are you sure you want to deactivate this level?

level.title: Level
level.guideTitleCreate: Create a new level in 3 simple steps
level.guideDescriptionCreate: Choose the type, add names, then confirm structure and status before saving.
level.guideDescriptionEdit: Update the fields below. Changes affect how levels appear in forms and lists.
level.stepOneHelp: Use Stage for top-level groups. Use Grade for child levels under a stage.
level.stepTwoHeading: Step 2 - Add English and Arabic names
level.stepTwoHelp: Enter clear names so admins and teachers can identify this level quickly.
level.stepThreeHelp: Set ordering, link grades to a parent stage, and control whether this level is active.
level.name: Level Name
level.nameEnHelp: Use a short, clear English label (for example: Primary).
level.nameArHelp: اكتب نفس الاسم بالعربية بشكل واضح.
level.kindStageHelp: Top-level category that can contain grades.
level.kindGradeHelp: A specific grade that must belong to a stage.
level.parentStageHelp: Every grade must be linked to one stage.
level.noParentStagesHint: Create at least one stage first, then return to create grades.
level.sortOrderHelp: Lower numbers appear first. Leave empty if ordering is not important.
level.activeHelp: Inactive levels are hidden from normal selection lists.
level.treeViewHint: Levels are grouped by Stage. Expand each Stage to view and manage its Grades.
level.treeNoGrades: No grades under this stage yet.
level.treeOrphanHint: These grades are not linked to an existing stage. Edit each one and assign a parent stage.
